description: Keep the @jordond/kit npm pin and the SHA-pinned jordond/kit workflow refs on the same release, in one PR. Usage: "extends": ["github>jordond/kit//renovate/default"]

packageRules.description: One PR for kit: the npm package, the setup action and the reusable workflows. `kit doctor --ci` fails when they are on different versions.
Always move the range in package.json (^0.6.0 to ^0.6.1), never only the lockfile: `kit doctor` compares the range with the workflow version comment.
Workflow refs stay `jordond/kit/...@<commit sha> # vX.Y.Z`: the SHA is pinned and the version comment moves with it.
